newsitem.title: CHINA: Cambodia's Sihanouk says no blessing for Ung Hot.
newsitem.headline: Cambodia's Sihanouk says no blessing for Ung Hot.

text.p: Cambodia's King Norodom Sihanouk on Thursday denied he had given his blessing to Phnom Penh's new government during a meeting in Beijing with newly appointed First Prime Minister Ung Huot.

"I never gave him the title of first prime minister which, in full legality, still belongs to you," Sihanouk said in a letter to his son, Prince Norodom Ranariddh, who was toppled by strongman Hun Sen last month.
"And I made this clear to his excellency Ung Huot himself," the king said, adding "His excellency Ung Huot replied that he understood."
"During the audience and the lunch on August 12, 1997, I never gave my 'blessing' to these Cambodian 'guests'," Sihanouk said.
"At the above mentioned lunch, I only raised my glass, saying to them 'To your health'. This conformed to our tradition," he said.
In Phnom Penh Ung Huot said earlier on Thursday that Sihanouk had given his blessing to Cambodia's new government during five hours of talks at the king's Beijing residence on Tuesday.
